episodes.title: A Taste of Familiarity
episodes.summary: On a quest to earn a three-star review, Han Beom-woo traces a copycat of his dish to a humble restaurant — where he clashes with its owner, Mo Yeon-joo.

episodes.title: The Stubbornness of Jungjae
episodes.summary: Yeon-joo signs a deal with Beom-woo — under certain conditions. They soon fight over every detail, from hiring to plating, until they find their groove.

episodes.title: Partially Soaked
episodes.summary: As false rumors of Jungjae's failure spread through town, Yeon-joo and Beom-woo hit snag after snag — until a frightening incident shakes the restaurant.

episodes.title: Love Is Like a Spark
episodes.summary: As the Jungjae team preps for the food truck competition, Yeon-joo and Beom-woo clash over their approach — but soon join forces for a shot at victory.

episodes.title: Neither Hot nor Cold
episodes.summary: After a tender moment between Yeon-joo and Beom-woo, an unexpected figure appears. The Jungjae team prepares for an international wedding tasting.

episodes.title: Jungjae Manual
episodes.summary: Beom-woo, Jin Myung-sook and Shin Choon-seung struggle to fill Yeon-joo's void when she unexpectedly disappears — until Beom-woo sets out to find her.

episodes.title: The Restaurant I Loved
episodes.summary: In Japan, Beom-woo and Yeon-joo grow closer as she prepares a recipe for her former boss. Beom-woo confronts Jeon Min about his intentions with Yeon-joo.

episodes.title: Scorched Recipe
episodes.summary: As Beom-woo scrambles to clean up a mess of his own making, the Jungjae team heads out on a trip — and his feelings for Yeon-joo deepen even more.

episodes.title: Imperfect Cooking
episodes.summary: The shocking truth shatters Yeon-joo and Beom-woo's relationship, leaving them both devastated. But soon, they receive surprising news about Jungjae.

episodes.title: Tastefully Yours
episodes.summary: Jungjae goes head-to-head with Motto in a showdown of taste. Can Beom-woo and Yeon-joo overcome their differences to come out on top?
